name: @zxc663/shisan-xinuo-workflow
description: 中文：十三希诺 Agent 工作流——把任何工程任务按三级跑道（L1 快速通道 / L2-S 短工作流 / L2-F 完整 9 步）+ L1/L2/L3 封闭清单速判 + 三模式推进的可审计 Agent 工程纪律 Skill。渐进式披露（406 条细则 33 类按 T1/T2/T3 三层加载，头部症状索引表）+ 细则一键检索端口（detail_lookup 探针 24/24，命中附修复模板）、注入核心 ≤6K 字符（常驻保留集完整）、hooks 纪律包注入（SessionStart 常驻提醒 + PostToolUseFailure 错误时刻 TOP 推送）、GATE 12 字段单源 + 开工状态行、跨会话留档一档制（agent-log 四区）+ 设计前先调研成熟设计、上下文主动管理（折叠协议 / 保留清单 / 紧凑档 / 模块锚点表 / 决策时效 / 场景化单发豁免）、纠偏续跑与并行依赖协议（Steer/Parallel）、触达端口（报错必经 / 预读 TOP / 取证行 / 回指强制）、经验回流（双击晋升）、路测与审计诚实口径（无头面注入断裂如实报）。四包交付：核心（纪律元工作流）+ 流程包（9 类工作流分册）+ 角色包（8 审查角色）+ 产品工程包（交互工程判据与门禁）。MIT。 English: Shisan Xinuo Agent Workflow — auditable engineering-governance Skill: three-lane task flow (L1 quick / L2-S / L2-F 9-step), L1/L2/L3 closed-list triage, three modes; progressive disclosure (406 items / 33 classes via three-tier T1/T2/T3 + symptom index + one-command detail_lookup with fix templates), slim injection core (≤6K chars, resident set intact), hooks discipline-pack injection (SessionStart reminder + PostToolUseFailure TOP push), 12-field GATE (caps/effort/stop_reason) + session status line, single-file agent-log archiving + research-before-design, proactive context management (fold protocol / preserver list / compact tier / decision expiry / single-shot doc exemption), steer-and-parallel protocols, touchpoint ports, experience promotion, roadtest-and-audit honesty (headless-face injection gap reported as-is). Ships as four independently installable packages (core / flows / roles / product). MIT.
author: 十三希诺
